summary:
史賽克受惠於醫療需求強勁與手術量增加，第二季營收與獲利雙雙優於市場預期。
• 每股盈餘為 3.69 美元，優於市場預期的 3.49 美元。
• 季度營收達 6.59 美元，年增率達 9.42%。
• 核心醫療設備與骨科手術需求保持強勁成長動能。
• 營運效率提升帶動獲利能力擴張。
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報展現強健的基本面與高於預期的獲利能力，對股價短期內具正面支撐。中長期需持續追蹤醫院資本支出預算、手術量復甦動能及成本控制成效。

需留意：總體經濟環境波動可能影響非急需手術的成長。；高通膨與供應鏈成本可能對利潤率造成潛在壓力。

summary_en:
Stryker reported strong Q2 earnings beating consensus estimates driven by robust medical demand and procedural volumes.
• EPS of $3.69 beat the consensus estimate of $3.49.
• Quarterly revenue reached $6.59 billion, representing a 9.42% year-over-year increase.
• Strong demand momentum continued across core medical equipment and orthopedic procedures.
• Improved operational efficiency drove margin expansion.

ai_view_en:
view: Strong fundamentals and profit beat provide positive near-term support for the stock. Mid-to-long term tracking should focus on hospital capital expenditure budgets, elective procedure recovery momentum, and cost control effectiveness.

Watch：Macroeconomic volatility could impact elective surgical procedure growth.; Persistent inflation and supply chain costs may exert downward pressure on margins.
